role: authoritative visual and technical baseline; not a quality promotion

limits: The collision result covers current scalp hair and eyebrow surfaces against the body only.
No clothing, clothing collision proxy, explicit body collision proxy, oral layer or engine runtime asset exists in r0001.
No Aevrynd runtime CPU, GPU, memory or multi-character benchmark has been run.

visualFailures: The face remains broad and flat through the orbital, malar and perioral regions, with weak skeletal landmarks.
The mouth opening reads as a dark cut and lacks convincing lip roll, commissure closure, teeth, tongue and oral depth.
The eyes lack convincing corneal depth, moist occlusion and natural lid contact; the white rim is visually dominant.
The frontal hairline exposes wire-like roots and the profile is obscured by a flat vertical curtain of strands.
The full-body silhouette has underdeveloped shoulder, rib-cage, elbow, wrist, hand, knee and ankle structure.
The skin response is smooth and uniform, without enough regional roughness, colour variation or microstructure.
Frame 33 preserves the same facial and hair weaknesses and does not yet prove production-quality deformation.
decision: Retain r0001 only as the fixed female-next comparison baseline. Do not export it into runtime and do not replace any website model.
nextAction: Build a geometry-first face-structure candidate that changes orbital, malar, jaw and perioral form while holding lighting, hair, skin and camera constant.
